tool_input.command: sleep 3; cat /private/tmp/claude-501/-Users-marsel-shamsutdinov-peekle/ee309bdf-bd7f-4b73-a4e9-b078a07f21ee/tasks/b5v67g63m.output; echo "--- settings hooks ---"; jq -r '.hooks | keys[]' ~/.claude/settings.json
cat -n crates/peekle-server/src/routes.rs; echo "=== sink.rs ==="; cat -n crates/peekle-server/src/sink.rs

ls -la fixtures/hooks/; for f in fixtures/hooks/pre_tool_use.jsonl fixtures/hooks/post_tool_use.jsonl; do [ -f "$f" ] && { echo "=== $f ($(wc -l < $f) lines) ==="; head -1 "$f" | jq -S 'keys'; }; done

jq -c '{tool_name, tool_use_id, tool_input: (.tool_input|tostring|.[0:120])}' fixtures/hooks/pre_tool_use.jsonl; echo "=== post: response shapes ==="; jq -c '{tool_name, tool_use_id, resp_type: (.tool_response|type), resp_keys: (if (.tool_response|type)=="object" then (.tool_response|keys) else null end), resp: (.tool_response|tostring|.[0:160])}' fixtures/hooks/post_tool_use.jsonl

jq -c 'select(.tool_name=="Read" or (.tool_response|tostring|test("42|not exist";"i"))) | {tool_name, resp_type:(.tool_response|type), resp:(.tool_response|tostring|.[0:300])}' fixtures/hooks/post_tool_use.jsonl | tail -5

echo "pre: $(wc -l < fixtures/hooks/pre_tool_use.jsonl)  post: $(wc -l < fixtures/hooks/post_tool_use.jsonl)"; echo "--- pre tool_use_ids ---"; jq -r '.tool_use_id' fixtures/hooks/pre_tool_use.jsonl > /tmp/pre.ids; jq -r '.tool_use_id' fixtures/hooks/post_tool_use.jsonl > /tmp/post.ids; echo "in pre but not post:"; comm -23 <(sort /tmp/pre.ids) <(sort /tmp/post.ids) | while read id; do jq -r --arg i "$id" 'select(.tool_use_id==$i) | "\(.tool_name): \(.tool_input|tostring|.[0:80])"' fixtures/hooks/pre_tool_use.jsonl; done

ls -la fixtures/hooks/*.jsonl; echo "=== user_prompt_submit ==="; [ -f fixtures/hooks/user_prompt_submit.jsonl ] && jq -c '{keys: (keys), prompt: (.prompt // ""|.[0:60])}' fixtures/hooks/user_prompt_submit.jsonl || echo "not captured yet"

pkill -f 'capture-hooks.sh'; sleep 2; pkill -f 'peekle-capture.mjs'; sleep 1; echo "--- settings hooks after restore ---"; jq -r '.hooks | keys[]?' ~/.claude/settings.json 2>/dev/null || echo "(no hooks key: restored to original)"; echo "--- backups ---"; ls -1 ~/.claude/settings.json.peekle-bak.* 2>/dev/null | tail -3
